# 9 Best Patreon Alternatives for Creators in 2026

Compare fees, features, and fit across 9 Patreon alternatives to find the platform that matches how you sell.

In this article:

New features, product updates, trend breakdowns, and creator stories.

The best Patreon alternatives in 2026 are Fourthwall, Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, Sellfy, Podia, Gumroad, Substack, Memberful, and Mighty Networks. Fourthwall is the top pick for creators who want native merch alongside memberships. Creators are switching from Patreon because its standard plan now takes 10% of membership and one-time purchase revenue for pages published after August 4, 2025, and new pages can't use the legacy merch feature.

Patreon is one of the best-known platforms for recurring creator memberships. It gives creators mature membership tools, discovery features, and a mobile app without an upfront monthly subscription.

But its standard plan now takes 10% from membership and one-time purchase revenue for creator pages published after August 4, 2025. Processing and payout fees come on top. New creator pages cannot add Patreon's legacy Merch for Memberships feature, which remains limited to creators already using it on a Pro or Premium monthly-billing plan.

In this guide, we'll explore 9 Patreon alternatives for different creator businesses, including simple tip jars, paid newsletters, courses, communities, merch, and all-in-one storefronts. 

## Patreon Alternatives at a Glance

The fee estimates below use the same scenario for each membership platform: 

- $1,000 in monthly revenue from 100 separate $10 US web-card payments

They include published platform fees, standard processing, and monthly plan costs where applicable. They exclude taxes, refunds, currency conversion, international cards, and app-store purchases. 

Actual costs change with payment size, payment method, plan, location, and payout method.

> Heads up: For reference, Patreon's standard plan costs about $159.25, or roughly 15.9%, on this same example: a 10% platform fee, 2.9% + $0.30 processing per payment, and a $0.25 payout fee.

| Platform | Best for | Standout features | Starting pricing | Estimated effective cost on the example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fourthwall | Creator brands combining memberships, merch, and digital products | Branded storefront, native POD, digital products, donations, creator integrations | Free; Pro $19/mo or $15/mo annually | 10.9% on memberships |
| Ko-fi | Artists and hobbyist creators accepting tips, commissions, and memberships | 0% fee on one-time tips on Free, instant direct payments, shop and commissions | Free; Gold $12/mo replaces the 5% fee with 0% | About 10.9% to 11% on Free |
| Buy Me a Coffee | Solo creators wanting low-friction tips and memberships | No-account one-time support, memberships, posts, digital shop | Free | About 11.9% for subscriptions |
| Sellfy | Digital creators and merch sellers who prefer a fixed monthly platform cost | Hosted store, subscriptions, digital products, POD, built-in marketing | Starter $29/mo or $22/mo annually | About 8.8% on monthly Starter |
| Podia | Coaches and educators selling courses, downloads, and community access | Course hosting, community, website, email, coaching | Mover $49/mo or $42/mo annually | About 15.8% on monthly Mover |
| Gumroad | Creators selling downloads, software, and simple memberships | Fast product setup, direct checkout, Discover marketplace, Merchant of Record | No monthly fee | About 20.9% on direct $10 payments |
| Substack | Writers building free and paid newsletters | Email publishing, reader network, paid subscriptions, podcast support | Free to publish | About 16.6% on paid subscriptions |
| Memberful | Publishers adding memberships to an existing website | WordPress integration, private podcasts, Stripe ownership, content gating | $49/mo | About 15.7% |
| Mighty Networks | Community-first memberships, events, and courses | Community spaces, courses, livestreams, events, apps | Launch $79/mo or $950/year | About 15.8% on Launch; published range about 15% to 17.9% |

## 1. Fourthwall

Average customer rating: Trustpilot: 4.3 (350+ reviews)

Fourthwall is the best alternative to Patreon for creators, including musicians, video creators, artists, and podcasters, who want a fully branded storefront combining memberships, merch, and digital products.

Fourthwall gives you a no-code website and shop where you can publish free or paid membership content, sell downloads, accept donations, and launch physical products. 

Memberships support monthly or annual pricing, free tiers, Discord roles, private podcast feeds, members-only products and discounts, and content formats including text, audio, video, polls, and livestreams.

The biggest difference for creators comparing Fourthwall with Patreon is merch.

You can choose from hundreds of customizable print-on-demand products without buying inventory first, or sell products you already own. For Fourthwall-produced catalog orders, we handle production, shipping, and end-customer support. 

Fourthwall also acts as Merchant of Record for applicable transactions processed through the platform.

One creator described the combined workflow this way: 

> Customer support went out of their way to find an answer for me regarding a shipping issue. Besides that, Fourthwall is a stellar platform all around. They make it easy for creators to create and sell merchandise and memberships. Recommended!

Yecats Mailbox · Trustpilot 5★

### Pros of Fourthwall

- Memberships and commerce in one storefront, including merch, digital products, donations, and member content
- Native print-on-demand fulfillment without upfront catalog inventory
- Fully branded website with custom domains and no-code design tools
- Merchant of Record support for applicable platform transactions
- Creator integrations for platforms and tools including YouTube, Twitch, Discord, Spotify, TikTok, email services, and more

### Cons of Fourthwall

- There is no built-in marketplace that automatically supplies an audience
- Memberships carry the same 5% platform fee on Free and Pro
- Support for self-fulfilled products remains your responsibility

### A Summary of Fourthwall's Trustpilot Reviews

Fourthwall is rated 4.3 out of 5 from 350+ Trustpilot reviews. Reviewers commonly praise the platform's ease of use, product quality, and customer support.

### Fourthwall Pricing

Fourthwall's Free plan has no monthly subscription. Platform fees break down by revenue type:

- Catalog merchandise: no separate percentage fee on the margin above the published base cost
- Creator-owned physical products: 0% platform fee
- Donations: 0% platform fee
- Memberships: 5% platform fee
- Digital products: 5% on Free, 0% on Pro

Pro costs $19 per month or $180 per year. Standard domestic US card processing is 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Fourthwall doesn't publish a separate payout fee, and standard payouts are sent each month automatically once the balance reaches $25.

### Fourthwall vs. Patreon Pricing Comparison

Here's what running your business costs on each platform:

| Cost or fee category | Fourthwall | Patreon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Monthly platform subscription | $0 on Free Pro is $19/mo or $180/year | $0 |
| Membership platform fee | 5% on Free and Pro | 10% standard for creator pages published after August 4, 2025 Legacy pages may pay 5%, 8%, or 11% |
| One-time support | 0% platform fee on donations | 10% standard platform fee on one-time purchases |
| Merch | 0% platform fee on catalog-product margin Product base cost applies | Merch for Memberships is available only to creators already using it New creator pages cannot add it |
| US web card processing | 2.9% + $0.30 | 2.9% + $
